---
title: "Guestbook"
format: html
---

Leave me a message! *Simple Markdown formatting is supported*.

```{=html}
<div style="max-width: 650px; margin: 0 auto;">
  
  <!-- FORM -->
  <form id="msg-form" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;">
    
    <!-- 1. 补齐回复状态提示条（默认隐藏） -->
    <div id="reply-banner" style="display: none; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; background: rgba(150, 150, 150, 0.12); border-left: 2px solid currentColor; font-size: 0.85em; font-family: inherit; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--global-radius, 0.2rem);">
      <span id="reply-text" style="opacity: 0.8;"></span>
      <button type="button" id="cancel-reply" style="background: none; border: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1em; opacity: 0.7;">&times;</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Inputs -->
    <input type="text" id="msg-name" placeholder="Name (Required)" required 
           style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 1px solid currentColor; opacity: 0.6; border-radius: var(--global-radius, 0.2rem); padding: 0.8rem; font-family: inherit;">
           
    <input type="text" id="msg-website" placeholder="Website (Optional)" 
           style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 1px solid currentColor; opacity: 0.6; border-radius: var(--global-radius, 0.2rem); padding: 0.8rem; font-family: inherit;">
           
    <!-- 2. 补齐 maxlength 和字数统计 -->
    <textarea id="msg-content" placeholder="Message (Required)" required rows="4" maxlength="3000"
              style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 1px solid currentColor; opacity: 0.6; border-radius: var(--global-radius, 0.2rem); padding: 0.8rem; font-family: inherit; resize: vertical;"></textarea>
    <div id="char-count" style="font-size: 0.8em; opacity: 0.6; text-align: right; margin-top: -0.5rem; font-family: inherit;">0 / 3000</div>
    
    <button type="submit" id="msg-submit" class="button" style="padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem; align-self: flex-start; font-family: inherit; border-radius: var(--global-radius, 0.2rem);">Post Message</button>
  </form>
  
  <p id="msg-feedback" style="display: none; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 1rem; opacity: 0.9;"></p>
  
  <hr>
  
  <!-- MESSAGES -->
  <div id="messages-container">
    <p style="opacity: 0.7; font-family: inherit;">Loading messages...</p>
  </div>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<script src="scripts/mymessage.js"></script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js"></script>
```
